Lemma
[$L^1$-norm of the heat kernel on a closed manifold] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0357, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0358 ↗ thm:chow-iii-closed-evolving-heat-kernel 1. ch26:26.5\group Heat Kernel Mass

If $C_1=\sup _{\mathcal M\times [0,T]}|\mathcal R-Q|<\infty $, then \[ e^{-C_1(\tau -v)}\le \int _{\mathcal M}H(x,\tau ;y,v)\, d\mu _{g(\tau )}(x) \le e^{C_1(\tau -v)}. \]
Proof

\sketch Differentiate the integral, use $LH=0$, and apply Gronwall to $I'=\int (\mathcal R-Q)H$.

□
